title: Test-Day Checklist
summary: What to bring, how the day runs and how to pace yourself in both parts of the test.

blocks.title: The days before
items: Book only on GOV.UK. The official fee is £23.
Check the date, time and address of your test centre.
Plan your journey: you must arrive 15 minutes before your test starts.
Do one full practice run of both parts.
Read the traps on your maps one last time.

blocks.title: Bring with you
items: Paper licence only? Bring a valid passport too.
Changed your name since booking? Bring proof, like a marriage certificate or deed poll.
Without the right documents the test is cancelled and you lose the fee.

blocks.title: At the centre
blocks.text: Switch your phone off before you go in. Your belongings go in a locker (or a clear box if there are no lockers).

blocks.title: Part 1: multiple choice
items: 57 minutes for 50 questions is just over a minute each.
3 of the questions are about a short video clip.
Not sure? Pick your best answer and move on; come back at the end if you have time.
Read every word: 'most', 'least', 'must' and 'should' change the answer.

blocks.title: Part 2: hazard perception
items: 14 clips: click when a hazard starts to develop.
Wrong clicks don't cost points; clicking continuously or in a pattern scores nothing.
One clip has two developing hazards.

blocks.title: After the test
items: You must pass both parts in the same test.
Passed: your certificate lasts 2 years. You must pass your practical test before it runs out.
Failed: you take both parts again and have to wait at least 3 working days.
